summary: Chagee Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K on August 28, 2026, announcing its unaudited financial results for Q2 2026. The filing contains operational and financial highlights, including revenue of RMB3,414.6 million, operating income of RMB524.7 million, and GAAP net income of RMB464.8 million. This is a routine earnings release and does not involve any special situation such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing is informational in nature and provides no deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors. There are no special-situation events to monitor.
